# name: # kind: safety = warn before turning off; standard = free to switch; optin = off unless you ask. states = allowed values: on (block), ask (you get a permission prompt each time), off (allow). Blocks fall back to block where no prompt can be shown.

if ON: Blocks commands that destroy data or the machine (recursive delete of root or home, dd, mkfs, curl piped to sh, git reset --hard, DROP/TRUNCATE).
if OFF: Those commands run with no check. One typo can wipe files or a database.
if ASK: Those commands stop at a permission prompt. You approve or deny each one. Claude cannot answer it.

if ON: Blocks writing API keys and tokens into code, and secrets in shell commands.
if OFF: A key can land in code and in git history. Leaked keys must be rotated.

if ON: Blocks Claude from reading .env, ssh keys, cloud credentials, or dumping env vars.
if OFF: Claude can read your secrets and send them into the chat.
if ASK: Reads of secret files stop at a permission prompt. You approve or deny each one.

if ON: Asks you first before Claude edits .claude/settings*.json, .claude/hooks/ or .mcp.json. In a session with no prompt it blocks instead.
if OFF: Claude can change its own rules and hooks with no prompt.
if ASK: (Same as ON: this guard already asks.)

if ON: Blocks git push and the GitHub tools that commit straight to a remote branch. You push.
if OFF: (Not offered here. Only you can allow these for good, with the env var MOGGER_PUSH_GUARD=off or MOGGER_ALLOW_PUSH=on.)
if ASK: Each plain push of a feature branch stops at a permission prompt. Force pushes and protected branches stay blocked.

if ON: Blocks merging a PR, merging while on a protected branch, auto-merge, and deleting repos or branches on GitHub.
if OFF: (Not offered: merging is always your call.)
if ASK: Each merge stops at a permission prompt. You approve or deny it.

if ON: Blocks production deploys and publishes (npm publish, kubectl apply, terraform apply, vercel --prod, docker push, db migrate, gh release).
if OFF: (Not offered here. Only you can allow these for good, with the env var MOGGER_DEPLOY_GUARD=off.)
if ASK: Each deploy or publish stops at a permission prompt. You approve or deny it.

if ON: Blocks CLIs that move or configure money (stripe create/refund, aws billing, gcloud billing, paypal).
if OFF: (Not offered here. Only you can allow these for good, with the env var MOGGER_MONEY_GUARD=off.)
if ASK: Each money command stops at a permission prompt. You approve or deny it.

if ON: After Claude reads web or MCP content, asks before curl, wget, nc, scp, ssh. Speed bump against prompt injection.
if OFF: Text from a web page can make Claude send data out with no prompt.

if ON: Checks new npm/pip packages exist and are not brand new. Stops made-up package names.
if OFF: Claude can install a fake or look-alike package.

if ON: Checks new packages against the OSV list of known malware.
if OFF: Known-bad packages are not checked. The package age check still runs.

if ON: Blocks edits to files outside the current task.
if OFF: Claude can change any file during a task.

if ON: Runs your tests before Claude may say it is done. Sends Claude back if they fail.
if OFF: Claude can finish with failing tests.

if ON: Blocks "done" when code changed but no test was added or changed.
if OFF: Claude can change behaviour with no test.

if ON: Records the real result of test runs. The reviewer gate needs it.
if OFF: Gates trust what an agent wrote, not what ran.

if ON: Warns when an edit removes test assertions or adds skips.
if OFF: Claude can make tests pass by weakening them. No warning.

if ON: Blocks "done" when nothing ran after the last code edit.
if OFF: Claude can say "done" with no proof.

if ON: Takes an undo snapshot before the first edit of a task (use mogger:rewind to go back).
if OFF: No snapshots. You cannot undo with mogger:rewind.

if ON: Warns when code handles card data or money by hand instead of a payment provider.
if OFF: No warning about home-made payment code.

if ON: Warns about risky code: eval, SQL built from strings, open CORS, disabled TLS checks.
if OFF: No warning on those patterns.

if ON: Keeps DECISIONS.md append-only. Blocks edits to old entries.
if OFF: Old decisions can be rewritten.

if ON: Blocks reading files over 350 lines in full. Sends Claude to the bulk-reader agent. Saves context.
if OFF: Big files are read in full. Context fills faster.

if ON: Warns when code uses a function, import or file that does not exist.
if OFF: No warning on made-up references.

if ON: Warns on missing timeouts, unhandled errors and unbounded loops.
if OFF: No warning on those gaps.

if ON: Warns on huge files and copy-pasted code.
if OFF: No warning on file size or duplication.

if ON: Warns on weak tests (no assertions, always-true checks).
if OFF: No warning on weak tests.

if ON: Stops Claude after repeated failed fixes of the same error. Tells it to rethink.
if OFF: Claude can loop on one failing fix.

if ON: Nudges at the 5th identical tool call in a row. Blocks the 8th identical failing call.
if OFF: Claude can repeat the same call many times.

if ON: Hints to pipe test and build output through tail or grep. Never blocks.
if OFF: No hints. Long output may fill context.

if ON: Tells you once when a repo ships Claude settings, hooks or .mcp.json.
if OFF: No notice when a repo ships config that runs commands.

if ON: Writes a handoff note before context is compacted.
if OFF: No handoff note on compaction.

if ON: Records edits and a test baseline. test-tamper and tests-added need this.
if OFF: No edit log. test-tamper and tests-added lose their data.

if ON: mogger talks in its own dry voice: a few fixed lines ("Not on my watch.", "Mogged.") and a livelier status bar. Warnings and errors stay exact.
if OFF: Plain voice. Same checks, same messages, no catchphrases.

if ON: Blocks "done" on UI or server tasks until the app has been started and checked.
if OFF: Claude may say "done" without starting the app.

if ON: Test and smoke gates apply to every task, not only when a TASKS.md exists.
if OFF: Gates apply only on tracked tasks.

if ON: Scope guard allows files from every open task. Use for parallel tasks.
if OFF: Scope guard allows only the current task's files.
